question: Town P is to the west of Town Q. Town R is to the north of Town P. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the south of Town S. Town Q is to the southeast of Town T. What is the position of Town P with respect to Town T?
solution:
**Given: **Town P is to the west of Town Q. Town R is to the north of Town P. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the south of Town S. Town Q is to the southeast of Town T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/239d5ef1580757a4519191085f89ef7405fe002c1834c58729351cc9bac5adf7.png] 

Thus, Town P is to the Southwest of Town T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
